task: Your client report is due Friday. The sales data arrived three days late, so you need until Tuesday. Write the message to your manager.

parts.label: Client report and Friday deadline
parts.missed: Name the client report and its Friday deadline.
parts.evidence: the client report is due Friday

parts.label: Reason for the delay
parts.missed: Say the sales data arrived late.
parts.evidence: The sales data arrived three days late

parts.label: New deadline of Tuesday
parts.evidence: I need until Tuesday to finish it

parts.label: Offer to limit the impact
parts.missed: Offer a draft or finished sections by Friday.
parts.evidence: I can send the finished sections by Friday

parts.label: Manager's agreement or input
parts.missed: Ask whether Tuesday works for your manager.

parts.label: No blame
parts.missed: Say what happened, not whose fault it is.

model: Hi Sam, the client report is due Friday. The sales data arrived three days late, so I need until Tuesday to finish it. I can send the finished sections by Friday. Would Tuesday work for you?
